title: nan
authors: Yang M.; Jia F.; Hou X.; Wang X.; Rushworth A.; Sun X.
key_contribution: Provides an experimental evaluation of LiDAR-IMU SLAM algorithms under feature-degraded GPS-denied environments with quantitative accuracy/robustness comparison and practical selection insights.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
